method.model: Current shipping partner-orders.newMonthlyTimingDistillery; no Lab engine; no state injection or save-data file access.
method.supply: Single legal fill at month0, age through actual tickDistillery; chemistry independently checked with ageCask. Reference40 is proportional analysis only, never a playable mutated state.
method.demand: One fresh first release; no prior reputation or approved stores. Each tier shares exact bottled initial state. Up to60 sale months; reject shop offers. Extraction wall-clock excluded from this isolated profile comparison.
method.policy: New game; one AmberTime brand; scheduled starts at months divisible by12/perYear. Starts refused by current model are skipped and reported; no extra income, rescue, loans or early cash-recovery bottling. Manual extraction65/refill consumes65 model steps,60 per monthly boundary. At target age full bottling and standard listing. Partial takes10 at6, remainder24. Automatic first fill/manual1 at age6 unlock both paid staff, thereafter scheduled once commissions and stock-linked10/threshold5 reservations from age6. All monthly cask decisions choose wait/last; funds decision stops. If scheduled fast production makes hiring unaffordable at first bottling, the intended automation arm stops as hire-budget (no invented funds or fallback policy). Retail-only declines all shop offers; stores arm approves liquor/supermarket and declines department to isolate recurring normal channels. Stockouts measured at settlement boundary incl startup and after first listing separately; sellout duration is last sale month minus bottling month.
method.limitations: Fixed deterministic policies, not optimized play. Occupancy limits can invalidate planned annual rates; actual finite cash stops retained. 40L is a requested reference, while actual legal maximum is39.77L. No physical/UI/fun verdict.
